# DIARRHEA WITH CHOLERA (VIBRIO CHOLERAE)

## 

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Sanford Guide article: Gastroenteritis, Vibrio cholerae
DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017, 65(12):45-80
Up-to-Date article: Cholera: Treatment and prevention
Therapy:
## Primary Treatment

Aggressive hydration and electrolyte replacement are essential.

## Antimicrobial treatment

## Inpatient

Preferred:
Doxycycline 300 mg PO one-time dose [DI]

Alternative:
Ciprofloxacin 1000 mg PO one-time dose [R,DI]
< OR >
Azithromycin 1000 mg PO one-time dose [M]
